layouts.house_scene:
COMPOSITION: a wide, opaque, painted night-time scene filling the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge. The house is the clear hero: centred, seen from the front in a slight 3/4 view, standing on its ground about two thirds of the way down the frame, its full height taking about 60% of the canvas height, nothing cropped. A short glowing dirt path leads from the bottom of the frame to its front door. The setting around it sets the scene but stays simpler and slightly darker than the house so the house reads first. A starry night sky with the moon.
NO FOG: no mist, haze, fog banks or ground smoke anywhere; the air is perfectly clear and the whole scene is crisp and readable.

z1.subject: The Pumpkin Fields house in its home zone: rolling autumn farmland at night, a glowing pumpkin patch full of carved jack-o'-lanterns in pumpkin orange (#FFAA33), tall golden corn rows, a scarecrow, a crooked wooden fence, a windmill silhouette and autumn trees with red and orange leaves, a big full moon. Warm orange glow from the house windows and the lanterns.

z4.subject: The Haunted House on top of a rocky hill at the end of the trail: a winding stone stairway lined with flickering lanterns and jack-o'-lanterns leads up to it, old tombstones and dead trees on the slopes, a rusted iron fence with an open gate at the bottom, a huge full moon directly behind the house with bats circling the towers, a dramatic deep purple night sky. Grand and spooky, but spooky-cute, not gory.
